errors.evidence: The line starts at a value of approximately 35.6% in 2003, not 30%. The description mistakes the y-axis minimum for the starting data point.
The peak value of the line is in 2009, not 2008.
The peak value in 2009 is approximately 39.8%, not 42%. The description mistakes the y-axis maximum for the peak data point.
The value in 2010 is approximately 38.8%, which is significantly different from the stated 36%.
The value in 2014 is approximately 35.5%, not 34%.

errors.text_span: След 2018 г. линията започва да намалява
errors.evidence: The line does not simply decrease after 2018. It fluctuates (decreases, then increases, then decreases, then increases again) before the final sharp drop in 2023. This statement misrepresents the trend between 2018 and 2022.

errors.text_span: достига най-ниската си стойност от около 30% през 2023 г.
errors.evidence: The lowest value in 2023 is approximately 31.2%, not 30%. The description again seems to be using the minimum value of the y-axis scale instead of the actual data point value.
The description mentions the red line but fails to mention the blue circular markers present at each data point on the line.
